changelog: Your saved 'My words' corrections now survive AI Refine and translation too: before, the fix only applied to the raw dictated words, so Gemini's refine or translation could put the same misheard word back in. Now your saved correction is applied to Gemini's result as well — in the app's Smart Refine, the Translate tool and auto-translate, and in the voice keyboard's refine and translate — so the word you saved always wins.
